title: Abelian subpresheaf generated by restrictions of stage images
statement: Let J be a small category, F : J → Cat a diagram, P_j stage precoverages, V a cocone, Q a precoverage on V.pt, and assume all transition and cocone functors are continuous. Fix i, an abelian sheaf G on P_i, and sheaf maps alpha_t from each stage inverse image along t : i → j to restriction of H = V_i inverse image of G. No unit compatibility is required. For Y in V.pt define the generators to be H(r)(alpha_t(W)(y)) for t in Under i, W in F(t.right), r : Y → V_t(W) and a section y of the stage inverse image at W. Let B(Y) be the additive subgroup of H(Y) generated by this set. Restrictions preserve B by precomposing r, so these subgroups, their restricted maps, and subtype inclusions define an abelian presheaf B and a natural monomorphism B → H. All data are constructed from these explicit subsets.
